issues.claim: NICE NG126 and WHO 2024: missed miscarriage — mifepristone 200 mg orally, then misoprostol 800 µg (NICE: 48 h later; WHO: any route, at least 24 h later).
issues.problem: The routes are wrong in one direction. WHO Recommendation 31 limits 'any route' to buccal, sublingual or vaginal and does not list oral. NICE does allow oral. Written as 'WHO: any route' with no NICE route, the line reads as if WHO also allows oral misoprostol 800 µg, which the source does not say. WHO Rec 31 is also limited to under 14 weeks, and the line does not say so. All doses and intervals are correct.
issues.correction: NICE NG126 and WHO 2024: missed miscarriage — mifepristone 200 mg orally, then misoprostol 800 µg (NICE: 48 h later, vaginal, oral or sublingual; WHO, <14 weeks: buccal, sublingual or vaginal, at least 24 h later).
issues.evidence: WHO Abortion care guideline, 2nd ed. (2024), Recommendation 31 (p. 75–76): 'For missed abortion at < 14 weeks ... Recommended regimen: 200 mg mifepristone administered orally, followed by 800 μg misoprostol administered by any route (buccal, sublingual, vaginal).* ... * The minimum recommended interval between use of mifepristone and misoprostol is 24 hours.' (https://www.who.int/publications/i/item/9789240104204, PDF via iris.who.int bitstream dd3d3a9c-6446-4e79-a43c-093a41df46bd). NICE NG126 rec 1.11.1: '200 mg oral mifepristone and 48 hours later, 800 micrograms misoprostol (vaginal, oral or sublingual)' (https://www.nice.org.uk/guidance/ng126/chapter/Management-of-miscarriage).

issues.step: Note: WHO MCPC 2017 vs WHO 2024 misoprostol for incomplete abortion >12–14 weeks
issues.claim: WHO MCPC 2017 (incomplete abortion >12–14 weeks: misoprostol 200 µg vaginally 4-hourly, maximum 800 µg, or oxytocin 40 units in 1 L) differs from the later WHO 2024 Recommendation 36b (400 µg every 3 h).
issues.problem: The oxytocin regimen leaves out its infusion rate. The source gives 40 units in 1 L IV fluids at 40 drops per minute. Without the rate, the regimen cannot be given as the source states it. The misoprostol figures are correct; the source adds 'until expulsion'.
issues.correction: WHO MCPC 2017 (incomplete abortion >12–14 weeks: misoprostol 200 µg vaginally 4-hourly until expulsion, maximum 800 µg, or oxytocin 40 units in 1 L IV fluids at 40 drops/min) differs from the later WHO 2024 Recommendation 36b (400 µg every 3 h).
issues.evidence: WHO Managing complications in pregnancy and childbirth (2017), Table S-4 (p. S-13), Incomplete abortion, Medical Management, More than 12–14 weeks: 'Misoprostol 200 mcg by vagina every four hours until expulsion, maximum 800 mcg OR Oxytocin 40 units in 1L IV fluids at 40 drops per minute' (https://www.who.int/publications/i/item/9789241565493, PDF via iris.who.int bitstream 3bda1306-da5d-487d-b2ad-aff995112a7a).
